notes: The mechanic is a grant-budget component on the universe handle plus a legality-mask edge. An absent row means unbounded, which is what every save and every hand-built test world written before it carries, so nothing that worked stops working. The three constants also ship at values no run can reach, because the grid holds 300 nodes and only prerequisite-free ones in permitted cells are grantable. WORLD_SCHEMA_VERSION moved 5 to 6 -- material-stock holds revision 5 -- and sim-core's SNAPSHOT_VERSION did not move; no golden fixture diffs and goldens:regen was never run.

Measured in tools/w69 over four full 2400-tick runs per strategy: archivist sees action 8 masked for affordability on 4307 of 4804 ticks and for an empty candidate list on zero of them; denial-warden is closed by an empty list on 3508 ticks, having forbidden the grid; narrow-depth sees it legal on 76 percent of its ticks and asks zero times, because encourageResearch sits ahead of it and policyFor takes the first legal preference. Only uniform-random-legal ever grants, and it landed 1 grant from 234 submissions -- the other 233 were admitted by the mask and refused by the rules, because foundingKnowledgeCandidates excludes a node only when this mage holds it while grantPlan refuses any node with an instance anywhere.

Read supersededDeltas: it is a column of zeros. If any entry is non-zero, this regeneration was wrong and should be rejected. The notes above are carried forward verbatim from the baseline this one supersedes: they record measurements about this sweep that are still true, and a regeneration that dropped them would delete the reason a later reader trusts these numbers.
rationale: Provenance only: god action 16 added a seventeenth god-cost record, which moves contentRevision 162f80bf -> 87fdff6c and makes the gate refuse the old baseline as a cross-build comparison, correctly, since a delta across two content revisions is a category error rather than a regression. Behaviour is unchanged: every metric of every gate reported delta 0.00000 against the superseded baseline before this regeneration, regenerate-baseline.mjs printed 'no metric moved' for all three, and a paired re-run of the draconic species sweep is bit-identical across all ten pool strategies. Nothing here is a claim that behaviour moved. These numbers are a measurement and not a balance claim: release-plan.md forbids any balance claim before 0.5.0. The universe remains degenerate in known ways and this branch measured a further one, which conditions every number in this file: scribeThroughputFor returns zero for a mage whose universityId is 0 and completeAffiliation has no production caller, so no mage a universe promotes for itself is ever affiliated. Measured over 100 runs per arm, 162 living human mages produce 0.05 grimoires while 4.3 living draconic mages -- whose single founder is affiliated and lives 18,000 months -- produce 76. Scribing tracks affiliated mages and not mages, so any gate metric that reads a library is reading the founding cohort.
